description: This file implements a device backend for a registry service, specifically a file-based backend that manages device registrations and credentials using file-backed services. It provides methods for asserting registration, reading, deleting, creating, and updating devices, as well as handling credentials operations. The class is annotated as a Spring @Repository and interacts with file-based registration and credentials services.

classes.name: FileBasedDeviceBackend
classes.description: A Spring-managed repository class that implements device and credential management functionalities using file-backed services for registration and credentials. Handles CRUD operations for devices and credentials, as well as persistence actions.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks if a device registration exists for a given tenant and device ID, with optional gateway ID; delegates to registration service.

methods.name: readDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specific tenant and device ID, including tracing span, delegating to registration service.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device and its credentials, optionally considering resource version, handling asynchronous operations and chaining delete calls.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device registration and initializes an empty credentials set, handling asynchronous steps and propagating results.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates an existing device registration with new data, delegating to registration service.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a specified tenant, type, and auth ID, with overloads to include tracing span or client context.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets credentials for a device, optionally checking resource version, delegating to credentials service.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all registration and credential data from the in-memory registry.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists current registration and credential data to files asynchronously.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads registration and credential data from files asynchronously.
